title: Republican Rep. Anna Paulina Luna calls for an investigation into the Patriot Front, blames Ben admin after white nationalists march on Washington - NewsBreak
text:
By Wonderwall.com Editors ,
2 days ago Rep. Anna Paulina Luna is calling for a congressional investigation into the white nationalist group Patriot Front following the organization’s large Independence Day march through downtown Washington, D.C., arguing the group was not adequately scrutinized during the Biden administration.
Calls for federal action against Patriot Front Anna Paulina Luna questioned why the group was not investigated under President Joe Biden. By: MEGA Luna, a Florida Republican, made the request in a post on X after Patriot Front members marched through the nation’s capital . The demonstration drew attention as hundreds of masked, uniformed participants carried flags, including several American flags displayed upside down.
“What I find odd about Patriot Front is how under [Joe] Biden they were never investigated. Well-funded. Never investigated,” Luna wrote.
“The FBI under Biden looked into Catholics instead. So, looks like @GOPoversight should do some digging,” she added, referring to the House Oversight and Government Reform Committee.
The white supremacist organization Patriot Front held a 400-person Independence Day march in Washington, D.C. By: MEGA The march reportedly included about 400 participants. Patriot Front has become one of the most visible white supremacist organizations in the United States through its highly choreographed public demonstrations, according to the Anti-Defamation League. The civil rights organization says the group has been responsible for distributing the majority of white supremacist propaganda across the country since 2019.
Patriot Front was founded in 2017 by Thomas Rousseau following the Unite the Right rally in Charlottesville, Va., according to George Washington University’s Program on Extremism. The group’s manifesto advocates for the creation of a white ethnostate.
The Trump admin’s response Interior Secretary Doug Burgum condemned the group’s ideology. By: MEGA During an appearance on CNN’s State of the Union , Interior Secretary Doug Burgum condemned the group’s ideology while defending its constitutional right to assemble and express its views.
“Certainly what they stand for is nothing that I could possibly agree with, but one of the foundational principles of the United States, which makes democracy messy, is free speech, and there are plenty of things that I see that I might personally find offensive, reprehensible, but in America, free speech is allowed and this is by the whole spectrum of things,” he explained.
Burgum did not say whether he would encourage President Donald Trump to publicly condemn Patriot Front or its demonstration.
Appearing later on the same program, Republican Rep. Buddy Carter sharply criticized the organization’s message.
“What I’ll say is that that is not the soul of America. Look, you know, we are all created equally. That is what our whole impetus is based on here in this country,” Carter told host Dana Bash .
“And I would just, I would just not ignore it, but I don’t pay that much credence to it, because that does not represent the soul of America. We in America believe in equality, and that is simply not reflective, certainly not of the Republican Party,” he added.
1.2K
